column3: Preserves active verbs for unloading and giving the camels straw and feed, rather than passives.
Preserves the repeated release from the oath, with coming to the family and their possible refusal stated separately.
Preserves “turn to the right or to the left” rather than “go elsewhere”.
Preserves “we cannot speak bad or good to you” rather than “we have no choice in the matter”.
Preserves “days or ten” rather than “ten days or so”.
Preserves the image “ask her mouth” rather than “ask her opinion”.
Preserves “thousands of ten thousands”, the singular “gate”, and those who hate the offspring.
